subject: Last-mile close: deal alignment and final forecast adjustments
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@brightcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Last-mile close: deal alignment and final forecast adjustments

Team / Samir —

We're in the final window for Q4 close and I want to make sure BrightCloud is reflected correctly in the forecast and that we have a realistic commit for ops/finance. Quick asks:

- Samir: can you confirm current PO status and whether procurement has a hard signature timeline? If they can sign by 12/3 we can count this as committed for this quarter.
- Marissa / Ben: update the commit tracker (attached) with stage movement today. Include proposed discount (if any) and any pending blocking items.
- Finance & Ops: once we land the PO, we'll need a final SOW shipped same day — I attached the SOW draft for review.

I'm attaching redwood_commit_tracker.xlsx (single-sheet rollup) and a SOW draft. I also put a living version in the close playbook sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aGv-close-playbook — please update by EOD tomorrow PST.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.k@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_commit_tracker.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB); SOW_draft-BC_20261129.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir.p@brightcloud.com>

Cc: procurement@brightcloud.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Last-mile close: deal alignment and final forecast adjustments

Markus / Marissa / team —

Thanks for the note. Short update from procurement side:

- We're targeting an internal approvals meeting on 12/2; procurement has requested one small clarification on data residency SLA language in the SOW (see comment below). If that is the only ask they expect to route the PO the same day.
- Budget is approved; legal is OK with commercial terms but we may need to confirm standard security addendum countersign.

I'll confirm immediately after the 12/2 meeting. If we can get a final SOW with the small residency line updated, that will make the routing smoother.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Integrations, BrightCloud Analytics
samir.p@brightcloud.com

Markus / Samir / team —

I've updated the tracker and added staging notes. TL;DR:

- Current PS + Hosted ARR = $1.05M ARR (annualized), discounted 7% in our ask.
- Stage is Ops Ready -> awaiting one residency clause tweak in SOW per Samir.
- Our risk: if procurement delays beyond 12/3 we should treat as "probable" not "committed".

Attachments: SOW_draft-BC_20261129.pdf (I added the residency tweak under section 6.2; highlighted).

Ben: can you confirm whether we can hold the 7% discount given the reference architecture scope? If not, propose fallback at 9% and note in the tracker.

Action items:
- Ben: update pricing fallback in the tracker (by 10:30am PST).
- Samir: once your internal sign-off happens on 12/2, confirm and I will push final SOW and PO instructions to procurement.
- Markus: please tell finance to hold a provisional committed amount of $1.05M pending PO signed before EOD 12/3.

Thanks — I'll pester procurement but this feels like a one-clause finish.

—Marissa

Folks —

Thanks for the fast turn. Two quick operational notes before I lock this into the day-of rollup:

1) Marissa: please mark $1.05M as provisional committed in the sheet and add a one-line comment that PO expected 12/2 routing; finance will treat as committed only on signed date.
2) Ben: if you confirm the 7% discount can be honored, we accept — otherwise we fall back to 9% and I will sign off. I need your call by 11:30am PST so I can feed Q4 rollup to finance.
3) Laura: I'm looping you to keep execs informed. If procurement misses 12/3, we'll downgrade to probable and remove from committed numbers for the daily close snapshot.

I will push the finalized SOW to Samir immediately after Ben confirms pricing. Samir — appreciate the procurement heads-up; if legal needs the standard security addendum we can get it turned around same day.

Forwarded message follows below.

—Markus
